turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have until then. Owen found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of a class, nobody called me, and I want to know who decided that and on what basis.
I don't think this is productive.
"Productive." You asked for this meeting, Hale, so tell me who decided on that zero and whether anyone spoke to Owen before it went in.
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.
Then you have ten minutes to answer one question: was Owen heard before that zero went in? If you walk out without answering it, I'm going straight to the principal's office from here.
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.

"I'm done here." I'm writing that down, along with the fact that you entered a zero without calling me first. I'm not emailing anyone, Hale; I'm walking to the principal's office now, and the zero comes off or this goes to the board.
